page_title: BHA 1-3 CRY | Brighton v Crystal Palace 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' The free kick from close range, taken by Brighton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+4' Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.

90+4' What a sweet touch by Julio Enciso (Brighton) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
90+2' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Ismaila Sarr will be replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
90+1' Brilliant play from Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) to get past Bart Verbruggen in goal, but he fails to find the net from an acute angle.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is replacing Carlos Baleba.
87' 1 - 3 Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
86' The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
85' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Tyrick Mitchell and he is replaced by Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
85' Will Hughes comes off the pitch to be replaced by Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace).
85' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but Dean Henderson comes off his line to gather the ball.

82' 0 - 3 Goal! Eddie Nketiah plays in Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:3.
82' A long pass finds Julio Enciso (Brighton), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the middle of the goal, but Dean Henderson reacts well to make a good save.
81' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle.
79' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for infringement.
78' Julio Enciso (Brighton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
77' Julio Enciso (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Brighton work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
76' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) takes the free kick from the edge of the box. His decent attempt goes narrowly wide of the left post.
76' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Brighton have a free kick from a promising distance.
75' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Bart Verbruggen is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

73' What a miss! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Brajan Gruda (Brighton) comes onto the pitch so that Yasin Ayari can be given a rest.
72' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Evan Ferguson (Brighton) replaces Georginio Rutter.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Simon Adingra (Brighton) for Yankuba Minteh.
71' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) misses a big chance after the ball is crossed into the penalty box, with his shot going well wide of the right post.
69' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card.
69' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
68' Celebrations are cut short for Crystal Palace as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
68' That looked like a foul in the build-up play and the referee Michael Oliver is going to take a look using VAR.
67' The Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Michael Oliver rules it out for a foul.
65' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
64' A cross from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
63' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball has crossed the sideline. Brighton are taking a throw-in.
62' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
60' Julio Enciso (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
60' Here is a change. Jean-Philippe Mateta is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
60' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eberechi Eze.
58' The corner from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is cleared away by the defence.

58' Great solo effort by Julio Enciso (Brighton) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
56' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

56' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Dean Henderson pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to Brighton.
55' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
55' Joao Pedro (Brighton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
51' Joao Pedro (Brighton) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Dean Henderson comes off his line to intercept.
51' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
50' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

49' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
49' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
47' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
46' Half-time substitution. Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) is replaced by Julio Enciso.
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
45+3' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
45+3' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
45+1' Yellow card. Lewis Dunk (Brighton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is caught offside!

43' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
41' Shots on target – 1:3.
40' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

39' The game is pretty dull as Crystal Palace are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
38' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) and Georginio Rutter attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' The ball is cleared after Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

33' 0 - 2 Tyrick Mitchell shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 0:2.

32' Excellent touch by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
29' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
28' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
27' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is about to take a corner kick.
26' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.

25' That's unlucky! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
25' Brighton couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
24' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Brighton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
21' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
20' Total attempts – 3:1.
18' Crystal Palace fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
15' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
14' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
13' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
13' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
11' Joao Pedro (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is able to continue to play.
7' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
4' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
4' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.

3' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Dean Henderson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
3' The game is interrupted as Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is flagged offside.
2' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) sends the corner into the box, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts it and averts the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
